products.title: Full-Stack Multi-Vendor E-Commerce Platform with Admin & Vendor Portals
products.shortDesc: Complete Amazon/Flipkart clone with vendor dashboards, customer cart, order tracking, and Razorpay/Stripe payment gateway integration.
products.description: An enterprise-grade, high-performance multi-vendor e-commerce platform built on the MERN stack. Features comprehensive customer store, multi-vendor seller portal, master admin panel, product inventory management, coupon engine, dynamic category filters, customer reviews, and automated invoice PDF generation.

Database MongoDB collections & seed schema
Step-by-step Setup video & Installation Guide
Full Project Report (70+ pages IEEE format DOCX & PDF)
PowerPoint Presentation (PPT) for college viva / client pitch
1-on-1 Remote Setup Support via AnyDesk / Google Meet

products.title: AI Deepfake & Facial Manipulation Detection System with Explainable AI
products.shortDesc: Deep learning convolutional model for spotting synthesized media and video face swaps with Grad-CAM heatmaps showing exact manipulated zones.
products.description: Cutting-edge computer vision research project capable of classifying deepfake video clips and images with 96.4% test accuracy. Uses MesoNet and EfficientNet-B4 architectures combined with Grad-CAM heatmaps to visually explain why an image is flagged as fake or genuine.
deliverables: Pre-trained PyTorch weight checkpoints (.pth files)
FastAPI REST inference backend
Modern React dashboard with drag-and-drop video scanner
Comprehensive research synopsis, IEEE paper template & dataset prep scripts
PPT slides with architectural diagrams & confusion matrix
Free 1-on-1 setup session

products.title: Cross-Platform Food Delivery & Courier Mobile Application with Live Tracking
products.shortDesc: Swiggy / Zomato style multi-role mobile app (Customer, Restaurant Partner, Delivery Rider) with real-time GPS navigation.
products.description: Production-ready mobile application suite built with Flutter for both iOS and Android. Features live courier location tracking using Google Maps polyline routing, push notifications, cart management, real-time order status updates via WebSockets, and restaurant order fulfillment tablets.
deliverables: Flutter Customer App & Delivery Rider App source code
Node.js & Express live tracking backend
Firebase authentication & Firestore configuration templates
App release APK builds ready to run on Android phones
Full documentation report & architectural block diagrams
WhatsApp support for running on your device

products.title: Smart Home IoT Security Hub with ESP32, Facial Recognition & Cloud Dashboard
products.shortDesc: End-to-end IoT home automation and biometric door lock system with intruder alert photos sent directly to Telegram & mobile app.
products.description: Complete embedded systems project combining ESP32 microcontrollers, relay modules, sensors (DHT11, PIR, MQ2 Gas Sensor), and ESP32-CAM video streaming. Features automatic intruder detection, Telegram bot alerts with captured snapshots, and remote light/fan control from a responsive web dashboard.
deliverables: Arduino C++ sketches with pin mapping diagrams
Circuit schematics (.png & Fritzing CAD files)
Components shopping list with Amazon India links
Python facial recognition script for biometric door lock
Web dashboard code & Telegram Bot setup guide
Viva question-and-answer guide for college defense

products.title: Automated Algorithmic Crypto & Stock Trading Bot with Risk Management
products.shortDesc: Backtested automated trading bot implementing EMA crossovers, MACD, and RSI divergence with stop-loss and real-time trade signals.
products.description: A quantitative trading system with robust historical backtesting engine on Binance / Zerodha data. Executes paper trading or live orders, enforces strict 1:2 risk-reward ratio, monitors volatility, and broadcasts instant trade triggers with chart screenshots to private Telegram channels.
deliverables: Complete Python source code with modular strategies
Streamlit interactive backtest & analytics dashboard
Configuration guide for API keys & paper trading mode
Strategy performance reports (Sharpe ratio, max drawdown, win rate)
Documentation and deployment instructions on free cloud servers

products.title: Hospital Management & Telemedicine Portal with Real-Time Video Consultations
products.shortDesc: Complete hospital system with electronic health records (EHR), doctor appointment scheduling, prescription generation, and WebRTC video calls.
products.description: Comprehensive healthcare platform designed for clinics and hospitals. Supports 4 distinct portals: Super Admin, Doctors, Patients, and Pharmacy. Patients can book slots, pay consultation fees, join WebRTC encrypted video appointments, and download digitized prescriptions in 1 click.
deliverables: Next.js App Router full source code
Prisma schema & PostgreSQL migration scripts
WebRTC signaling server configuration
60+ pages project documentation with DFD & ER diagrams
PowerPoint viva slides
Installation support

products.title: AI Personal Fitness Trainer using Computer Vision Pose Estimation
products.shortDesc: Real-time webcam workout coach that tracks pushups, squats, and curls, counts reps, checks posture angles, and provides audio feedback.
products.description: An interactive AI fitness application leveraging MediaPipe 33-point skeletal landmark detection. Calculates real-time joint angles (elbow, knee, hip), automatically detects improper form (e.g., sagging back during planks), counts completed repetitions, and speaks audio cues via text-to-speech.
deliverables: Python OpenCV & MediaPipe core workout engine
Webcam browser interface
Exercise calibration scripts for custom workouts
Complete report documentation with trigonometry angle formulas
Project PPT presentation

products.title: College Examination & Automated Result Processing Management System
products.shortDesc: University examination portal for hall tickets, attendance, marks entry by faculty, CGPA computation, and bulk PDF marksheet generation.
products.description: A battle-tested academic management system built to streamline semester examinations. Allows professors to upload student marks via Excel spreadsheets, automatically computes SGPA/CGPA with grade point scaling, generates student rank lists, and prints individual official grade sheets with verification QR codes.
deliverables: Clean React frontend & Express API source code
MySQL relational schema (.sql dump file with sample students)
Excel bulk upload sample templates
IEEE standard project synopsis and 55-page final report
Project defense PPT presentation
